items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...ask a little bit about some of the old musicians you heard, like if you heard Buddy Batti...

ctx.x: Can you wait a minute? No. What time is it?

I don't have my watch, but it must be about close to 7 this time. We were a little bit late getting there. We'll be through to 7.30. We'd like to ask a little bit about some of the old musicians you heard, like if you heard Buddy Batti or Chris Kelly.
Yeah, I can tell you. Yeah, I can tell you. Some of the old timers. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
